comment: External quantitative signal on listed parents (fictional market-data vendor): one row per listed parent and trading day (Apr-2025 .. Sep-2026) with close price, 1-day and 30-day share-price change, 30-day volatility, CDS-like spread and its 1-day / 30-day change, the 52-week high / low and an at-52-week-low flag, the external rating and outlook in force (primary agency first), agency actions since the previous trading day, the market-signal entry events of the unified feed, and the group's APAC credit exposure (drawn lending + trade finance outstanding at the latest month-end, USD). Prices, spreads and exposure are point-in-time: never sum them across days - use the latest trading day (is_latest_trade_date). Grain: one row per listed parent issuer per trading day.
